text:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for streaming chat (timeouts + partial responses). I pulled a compact action list — need owners and target dates so we can roll these into the remediation sprint. TL;DR: reconnect/backoff client changes, server-side partial short-circuit, observability + alerts, e2e/sim harness, canary/runbook, and customer comms. Please ack and claim items.

trent: I can own reconnect/backoff tuning on the client SDK + server handshake retry behavior. Target: 2026-04-02 for PRs + 2026-04-06 for canary. Will include nonbreaking default config and opt-in aggressive backoff.

sophia: I'll take observability + dashboards. Tasks: add per-route "partial_response_rate" metric, latency p50/p95 for stream handshakes, and an alert for partials > 0.5% sustained 5m. Target: 2026-03-30. Will add runbook steps and alert playbook. :thumbsup:

li: I'll build an e2e sim that replays partials/timeouts and validate fallback logic. Will add tests to the CI job that runs nightly. Target for test harness: 2026-03-28.

trent: Quick config snippet I'm planning to propose in SDK (will paste here for review):
```json
{
  "reconnect": {
    "enabled": true,
    "initial_backoff_ms": 100,
    "max_backoff_ms": 2000,
    "max_attempts": 6,
    "jitter": 0.2
  }
}
```
This keeps defaults conservative but allows teams to tune. I'll open RFC PR today.

ops-bot: ticket created: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-STREAM-721> (owner: trent) and <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-STREAM-722> (owner: sophia) and <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-STREAM-723> (owner: li).

maya: Awesome, thanks. A few quick clarifications: 1) for server-side partial short-circuiting, we want a deterministic behavior: if partials > threshold, mark request for immediate safe-fallback (no retry) and log full KV state for 30s. 2) we need product-facing comms draft before canary if customer visible.

sophia: noted on the deterministic marking — adding event tag `stream.partial_shortcircuit=true` to logs. Also will add a dashboard panel for request IDs so we can correlate with traces.

trent: FYI, runtime team flagged possible interaction with continuous batching. I'll sync with @eng-runtime to ensure reconnect attempts don't trigger batch starvation. ETA for that sync: tomorrow.

deploy-bot: planned canary window: 2026-04-06 02:00-06:00 UTC, region: us-central1. Auto-rollback on partial_rate > 1% or latency p99 > baseline + 100ms.

maya: Proposal for closure: once PRs merged and canary passes, keep enhanced telemetry for 14 days, then run a short retrospective to confirm recurrence rate dropped. If good, we'll mark postmortem action closed and update the original incident doc. I'll triage customer comms draft with growth.

li: ACK — I'll add reproducible logs to the ticket and attach minimal repro harness.

sophia: ACK — will link dashboard and runbook in the ticket before canary.

trent: ACK — opening RFC PR now, will add link to RW-STREAM-721.

maya: Thanks all — we'll do a 15m sync Friday to confirm readiness. :calendar:
